HOSTING_RESOURCE_HINTS_CODES.doc: The hosting codes of the resource-hints dimension: hosting.resource-hints.*, why the host refuses the hints a plugin declares about itself (omx-contract's RESOURCE_HINTS, through the CLAP draft org.openmixer.resource-hints.draft/0 or the omxres LV2 properties). A refused declaration is trusted for none of its hints: every hint reads as unknown.

resourceHintsOutOfRange.doc: a figure below zero, or past what its hint's member holds

text.en: This plugin declared a resource hint figure below zero, or past what that hint can hold. None of its hints are trusted; every one reads as unknown.
text.ca: Aquest connector ha declarat una xifra de pista de recurs per sota de zero, o més enllà del que pot contenir aquesta pista. No es confía en cap de les seves pistes; totes es llegeixen com a desconegudes.

resourceHintsUnknownHint.doc: the declared mask sets a bit RESOURCE_HINTS has no hint for

text.en: This plugin’s declared hints set a bit that names no known hint. None of its hints are trusted; every one reads as unknown.
text.ca: Les pistes declarades d’aquest connector activen un bit que no correspon a cap pista coneguda. No es confía en cap de les seves pistes; totes es llegeixen com a desconegudes.

resourceHintsWrongUnit.doc: a figure not in its hint's unit: a flag that is not a boolean, a count, a time or a size that is not an integer

text.en: This plugin declared a resource hint figure in the wrong unit: a flag that is not a boolean, or a count, time or size that is not a whole number. None of its hints are trusted; every one reads as unknown.
text.ca: Aquest connector ha declarat una xifra de pista de recurs en una unitat incorrecta: un indicador que no és booleà, o un compte, temps o mida que no és un nombre enter. No es confía en cap de les seves pistes; totes es llegeixen com a desconegudes.
